name: Rustboro City
lines:
My Pokémon has a Naive Nature,
and my friend’s has a Jolly Nature.
It’s fascinating how Pokémon have
personalities!

stories up until around 10 years ago!
And they used to have a special area
called a “Pokémon Cable Club”!

I used it to teach my Pokémon how
to Cut down spiky trees.
